answer: To join, a name must pass Logged seed seller pantry seal, which works because a seal sellers renew after stall reviews. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Trying costs 300 separate visits, each one billed £29 at the door a name, and the money is gone whether the name passes or fails. That arithmetic is what keeps the seats for real agents. Every spiral is counted once. The lantern is checked, not assumed. One juniper, one entry.
